author: Swam H.L

title: Really nice and useful app.
body:
I do love Days Since alot actually.
My favourite things is that it is simple and attractive to use.

Simple and great utility in design.

However, I wish there was also a pause function for counters. Some things I may want to stop counting momentarily, instead of having to delete it and re-create again every time.

Personally I'd use it for counting the days my groceries stay in my fridge and many other personal things I want to be mindful of as well.

author: TheKDSA

title: Thankful
body:
I'm actually reallllyyyyyy thankful to Says Since. You guys have actually helped me quit a vice that really had a stronghold over my life. 

I also particularly loved having the widget on my phone to encourage me to keep going. 

but I must complain this, that you recently made it so that we have to pay to have the widget on our phone. It makes me annoyed because I've gone 74 days deep into my freedom and now you're forcing me to pay. It's not like I can switch to another app - i'm already committed to it.
